floor_concrete.notes: Poly Haven concrete_floor_worn_001 (3 x 3 m scan), regraded to a light sealed/polished grey, roughness lowered to 0.3-0.58, faint power-trowel swirl added to albedo/roughness. Saw-cut joints are modelled separately.

wall_precast.notes: Poly Haven plastered_wall_04 (3.2 m scan of a smooth grey industrial wall): its large horizontal bands were flattened (they betrayed the repeat) and the tone warmed to a light grey-beige precast panel. Panel joints are modelled separately.

wall_block.notes: Painted concrete block wall: 40 x 20 cm blocks (390 x 190 + 10 mm joints), running bond, 3 blocks x 6 courses per repeat, concave joints, porous block face under white/cream paint. Align V so courses are horizontal.

roof_metal.notes: Poly Haven box_profile_metal_sheet (2 m scan, trapezoidal ribs run along V), repainted from red to light-grey pre-lacquered steel (metalness 0, roughness 0.38-0.62). Use as the underside of the roof sheet; ribs run along the texture V axis.

plywood.notes: Poly Haven plywood (0.5 m scan), lightened to a natural birch/pine structural-plywood tone for ramp sides and quarter-pipe deck. Face grain runs along U (horizontal in the image).

turf.notes: Lime two-tone artificial grass (run-out / margins, like the Vida run-out): ~40 mm pile, tufts in rows 9.5 mm x 6 mm, olive thatch underneath. No CC0 artificial-turf scan found on Poly Haven/ambientCG.

brush.notes: Dense synthetic bristle mat (Vida Brush Parks style, dark green): tufts on a staggered 12.5 mm grid, ~400 bristles per 12 mm tuft, tufts almost touching, slight splay. One repeat = 0.5 m (40 x 40 tufts).

neveplast.notes: Neveplast NP30, one real module per repeat: 230 mm across x 400 mm along the fall line (square image, UV in metres with repeat 1/0.23, 1/0.40). 4 x 7 rings of 18 + 22 conical bristles (19 mm on an 8.5 mm base) around 35 mm holes, 4 mm screw holes, 1.5 mm seam. albedo / albedo_green = NEAR look (view >= 45 deg): cavity baked in (hole floor #3b3a37 / #1d2a22, base and bristle roots x0.6 in shadow), because three.js aoMap only darkens indirect light; *_far (512 px) = GRAZING look (bristles hide holes and base). The viewer builds the albedo/arm mip chains blending near -> far by the distance each mip is used at (materials.js npMips); Cycles blends by view angle (render.py). arm R = AO (hole 0.25), G = roughness, B = 0; sheen = linear sheen weight; height 16-bit (0 = hole floor, 1 = 28.2 mm) for Cycles bump/displacement.

net.notes: Knotted black PE safety net hung on the square: 45 mm mesh, 3.5 mm twisted thread, ~8 mm knots, 4 x 4 meshes per repeat (0.18 m; UV in metres). alpha = thread coverage (alphaMap + alphaHash in the viewer, mean 0.15), normal = round threads, twist and knots.

painted_ply.notes: Painted plywood side walls of park features, 2.44 x 2.44 m (boxUV tile 2.44, V = height from the floor): two 2440 x 1220 sheets laid landscape with 2 mm dirty joints, painted-over countersunk screws (sheet perimeter every 150 mm, studs every 610 mm), a few chipped heads, pine grain telegraphing through the paint, roller stipple, grey board scuffs (mostly 0.1-0.6 m high) and a dirt band at the bottom (0-0.2 m). Neutral albedo: tinted by the material colour (tintable).

hdpe.notes: Scuffed, waxed HDPE slide surface (box tops, tubes), 1 x 1 m; V = slide direction: fine edge streaks along V, smoother wax smears, grey scuffs. Neutral albedo, tinted by the material colour; arm G is the final roughness (armRough 1).

rail.notes: Yellow painted round rail, U = around the tube (0 = top), V = along (1 m): the top +-35 deg polished to bare scratched steel by the boards, chipped paint edges, dust underneath. arm B = 1 on the bare steel (metalnessMap).

rubber_floor.notes: ambientCG Rubber002: black rubber gym flooring with blue EPDM flecks; base neutralised to near-black, flecks toned down (-20 % brightness, -20 % saturation). ambientCG publishes no physical size; 0.5 m per repeat gives 2-6 mm flecks like real gym tiles.

asphalt.notes: Poly Haven clean_asphalt (2.1 m scan of fine-grained road asphalt), lifted slightly to a weathered mid-grey. Chosen over asphalt_02, whose long cracks repeat as parallel lines every 3 m on a street.

sidewalk.notes: Barcelona grey cement "panot de flor": 4 x 4 tiles of 20 x 20 cm per repeat (one tile = 0.2 m), grooved flower relief (centre circle, 4 petals, corner quarter-circles), per-tile tone, dirt in the grooves.

wood_veneer.notes: Poly Haven oak_veneer_01 (1.83 m scan), lightened/desaturated to a light natural oak and given a satin-lacquer roughness (0.38-0.55) for counters, benches and locker doors. Grain runs along V.

painted_metal.notes: Neutral near-white albedo: multiply by the paint colour (material.color). Orange-peel normal, faint scratches, roughness 0.29-0.43 (mean 0.36). arm.jpg B = 1 on purpose (2026-11-23): materials.js uses arm as roughnessMap AND metalnessMap (one shared ORM image in the GLB), so B must be 1 for the steel_painted_* metalness factor (0.2-0.35) to apply. Re-running procgen.py must keep B = 1.

fabric.notes: PVC-coated polyester / nylon plain weave (1 mm threads) for airbag and padding. Neutral light-grey albedo: multiply by the fabric colour. Semi-gloss coating, roughness ~0.45.

tiles_wc.notes: Glossy white ceramic wall tiles 40 x 20 cm (landscape, stack bond), 2 mm light-grey grout, 2 x 4 tiles per repeat, cushion edges and slight per-tile warp so reflections ripple like a real tiled wall.

interior.name: empty_warehouse_01
interior.notes: Empty industrial warehouse lit by fluorescent tubes and skylights. Use as interior IBL (environment/reflections); not meant to be shown as background.

exterior.name: kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky
exterior.notes: Midday partly cloudy sky with a strong sun, pure sky (no ground objects baked in, lower hemisphere is a plain ground tone): stands in for a Mediterranean industrial estate (polígono) in daylight. Rotate so the sun comes from the south.
